name: blender
description: Drive a connected Blender session over the official Blender Lab MCP server: inspect blend files and objects, execute bpy code, query the bundled Python API docs, capture viewport screenshots, and verify every change. Artyx connects over HTTP to a locally running blender-mcp process that relays to the Blender MCP add-on.

interface.tagline: Build and animate 3D scenes in a live Blender session.
prompts: Build a small treasure-room scene in Blender and animate the chest lid opening over 30 frames.

BLENDER_MCP_PORT.label: Blender MCP port
BLENDER_MCP_PORT.description: The port blender-mcp was started on. It listens on 8000 unless you passed --port.
